clause_audit.evidence: 100 publisher answers and98 independent receiver answers; actual ready-before-opened lifecycle and exact per-peer handles.49 decoded subscriber startups per scene are backed by49 durable actual flow facts within original shared8s.

clause_audit.requirement: Subscription is explicit, with exact Stream, Participant and kind selection.
clause_audit.evidence: No RTP at all before selection;49 exact/PID/PID+audio subscriptions per scene. Later publication reaches33 retained Participant selectors and excludes16 exact selectors. clause_audit.requirement: Server-side fanout resolves the authenticated physical binding and rewrites per-recipient Stream handles.
clause_audit.evidence: Every intended recipient independently decodes actual G711; all observed egress handles equal that physical receiver binding, with>10 marked frames per allowed recipient at original bounds. clause_audit.requirement: Active speaker is explicitly optional and never a correctness dependency.
clause_audit.evidence: Installed policy does not emit active-speaker events. Positive media/lifecycle outcomes depend on actual decoded media, signed observations and current authority, not missing advisory energy events. No new optional feature is advertised or invented as a prerequisite.

clause_audit.requirement: No SFU-specific wire envelopes are exposed.
clause_audit.evidence: Fifty publisher/receiver/subscription/departure readers reject unexpected envelope families; actual captures validate the unchanged canonical schema. Internal epoch scheduling adds no wire family. The same public SDK operates the small and fifty-member scenes.

clause_audit.requirement: A two-Participant Session uses the same envelopes and lifecycle as a fifty-Participant Session.
clause_audit.evidence: Current exact-binary two-peer subscription/replay and both-algorithm lifecycle/quality methods pass alongside fifty-member scenes.22 actual lifecycle envelopes validate canonical ready/opened/closed/quality shapes and signing algorithms; the same protocol code and APIs serve both sizes.
